title: CMake asset staging should create its stamp directory
body: The first queued `cmake --build build --parallel 4` failed because `cmake -E touch` could not update `build/application/main/vixen_stage_assets/510925ea10d7f0cf.stamp` when the parent directory was absent. I recovered with `mkdir -p build/application/main/vixen_stage_assets` and reran the same queued build successfully. Make the staging rule in VIXEN/cmake/VixenAssets.cmake create the stamp parent before touching the stamp.

title: Windowed capture should include provisioned X11 libraries in its runtime path
body: The queued DZN run of `bash tools/run-vixen-windowed-captures.sh` failed with `VK_ERROR_INCOMPATIBLE_DRIVER`; `VK_LOADER_DEBUG` identified `libxcb-keysyms.so.1: cannot open shared object file`, although ProvisionWindowingDeps.cmake had provisioned it under `VIXEN/.windowing-deps/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu`. Exporting `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` to that directory let the capture app start. Have the supported capture/build launcher add the provisioned library directory to its runtime loader path. After this workaround, the old graph still failed to produce HUD captures due to independent baseline errors.
